coverage_override.reason: The target qualification, same-characteristic GY/conditional Deck summon alternatives, and HOPT are all parts of one activation effect.

effects.printed_clause: Target 1 monster in your GY destroyed this turn by Eldora, Extinction of Dysmandr, or the opponent's effect; Special Summon a different-name monster sharing a characteristic from your GY, or, if Eldora is in your GY, Special Summon it from your Deck instead. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The target filter verifies current-turn effect destruction, allowed source, GY targetability, and existence of a legal matching summon. The summon filter requires a different-name Monster sharing Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, or DEF. Normally it searches the GY; while Eldora is in the GY it extends that same matching-monster pool to the Deck, then Special Summons the selection in face-up Attack Position.

official_references.matched_structure: Compares monster Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF to establish shared characteristics.
Targets and Special Summons an eligible monster from the GY in a constrained battle position.

effects.review_note: Rejected the earlier defect claim: grammatically, 'it' refers to the previously specified different-name matching monster, not to the Spell Card Eldora. Extending the generic matching pool from GY to Deck is therefore literal.
